alt: Four columns: reproduced on the original grader, proved formally in Lean 4 and TLA+, tested side by side, checked on real runs.
caption: Four independent layers of evidence. Every finding's mechanism was demonstrated on the original grader; where a claim could be stated precisely it was also proved in Lean 4 or model-checked in TLA+; the fixes were tested side by side, almost every comparison three times (exceptions listed under How we verified); and a real agent run covers nine fixed tasks: seven were regraded with both graders (314 submissions), and the Lean Analysis effect was computed from the original grader's verdicts.
